head: codex/5342-v0918-wp07-records-signing
title: [v0.91.8][adl-v2][records] Add portable signed record contracts
body:
Closes #5342

Implements bounded ADL v2 record contracts with deterministic canonical bytes, real Ed25519 signing, external trust policy, replay protection, strict channel decoding, and fail-closed tamper rejection. Runtime v2 and Runtime v3 are untouched.

Exact FastWork validation passed: 1039 implementation LoC, 878 test/fixture LoC, 10 records tests, 5 tamper/channel tests, schema diff, repeated tamper proof, formatting, strict Clippy, COTS, scope, and dependency checks. The final gpt-5.5 review found no blockers.
